method.client_cohort: producer start in [measurement_start, measurement_start+30s); late confirmations and receipts retained
method.db_cohort: DB start in fixed measured window; late completions retained
method.throughput: events with timestamps in [start,end), counted separately for starts, confirms and receipts
method.cpu: PID+creation-time matched endpoint deltas of the 12 persistent owned processes and worker inside sampled window; observed transient identities are disclosed separately and not included in these endpoint CPU deltas; not whole-stack/cgroup/exited-process accounting
method.rss: sum of sampled RSS double-counts shared pages, not unique physical memory
method.native: B whole-worker-lifetime aggregate elapsed fields; no native per-event trace, CPU attribution or 30-second cohort native timing
method.checksum: client valid flags and exact run IDs verified; payload bytes are not retained, so audit cannot independently rehash transmitted payload
method.comparisons: only A versus B within this session; report eligibility per predeclared pair, retain invalid-pair observations descriptively; no absolute comparison to prior sessions

same_executor_cleanup.scope: Historical same-executor witness; separate audit namespace does not recheck PIDs as live process identities

checksum_evidence.client_semantics: Raw valid flag records same run property plus SHA256(received body)==SHA256(expected deterministic payload). Validity is checked after receipt timestamp and before manual ACCEPTED.
checksum_evidence.audit_limit: Wire/body bytes and computed received digests are not retained. This audit verifies pinned validation code, all valid flags and ID/send timestamp joins; cannot independently rehash actual received bytes.

interpretation.instrumentation_perturbation: P1 observed A/B absolute and relative differences characterize this pair only. One pair cannot establish a causal instrumentation cost, a worst-case bound, statistical significance or negligible overhead. P2 retained but ineligible.
interpretation.native_evidence: Pinned source semantics plus aggregate log elapsed fields and count reconciliation. Not independently timestamped per-event native evidence; no phase quantiles or phase/client event join possible.
interpretation.priority: Investigate work/query/data path first because its elapsed share is dominant, without equating all work to removable overhead. Begin/commit envelope only describes measured spans, not achievable savings.
interpretation.empty_claim: No usable message returned is not universally side-effect-free; expired-lease dead-lettering and poison-message rejection may commit inside claim.
interpretation.qualification: Volatile overlay/tmpfs; affinity only, no cgroup cap. Not SSD/ERP, actual durable storage cost, reliability, capacity or production qualification.
